description: This file defines an interface 'AuthTokenHelper' that provides methods for creating, expanding, and retrieving the token lifetime for JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) used for authentication and authorization purposes within the Eclipse Hono service platform.

classes.name: AuthTokenHelper
classes.description: An interface providing utility methods for handling JWT tokens, including creation and expansion, for user authentication in the system.

methods.name: getTokenLifetime
methods.description: Returns the duration used for calculating the expiration ('exp') claim of tokens created by this helper.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT containing user identity and authorities, with claims for subject ('sub') and authorities, and an expiration based on token lifetime.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a signed JWT token, returning its claims, and throws JwtException if invalid.
